Title: Training Future Olympians
Content: `bbtext(GLEN WERNER ROSEBOOM)` (Director of the Training Center): Everyone has an Olympic moment that they remember, whether they’re a little kid or as an adult, and I think that’s what the love of the Olympics has done for so many people — that `text(one)` fond memory. We built the training center in Colorado Springs back in `1978`.
`bbtext(LIONEL RIVERA)` (Mayor of Colorado Springs, CO): We have over `text(140,000)` people a `text(year)` come visit the OTC [Olympic Training Center], right here in Colorado Springs.

`bbtext(JAMES SCHERR)` (CEO of the US Olympic Committee): It’s a primary training center for both the United States Olympic team as well as the US Paralympic Team. We can provide an integrative program so that when an athlete comes here, the only thing they have to do is focus on their training.

`bbtext(BO SANDOVAL)` (Strength & Conditioning Coordinator): You see a lot of interactions, especially between the more experienced athletes who may have been to `text(one)` or `text(two)` Olympic games already. They offer a lot of advice to a lot of the younger athletes.

`bbtext(MIKE LEE)` (Leader of Projects & Technical Development): It’s important to be on the cutting edge so we can stay `text(one millimeter)` ahead or `text(one second)` ahead of our competition. “IAM Performance” is an enhanced digital recording that allows the athletes to get instant feedback of their training or their competition.

`bbtext(GLEN WERNER ROSEBOOM)`: It’s really around, can we think ahead of our athletes and coaches just even `text(one)` step, so we’re the behind-the-scenes group so they can only think about world-class performances when we deliver the world-class services.
`bbtext(LIONEL RIVERA)`: We have the opportunity for young people from around the world to come to Colorado Springs to train with our athletes.
`bbtext(JAMES SCHERR)`: This year we’ll have over `90` countries with `828` athletes participating.
`bbtext(GLEN WERNER ROSEBOOM)`: Right now we’re hosting `text(three)` Ugandan weight lifters for `text(six months)` prior to the games.
`bbtext(BO SANDOVAL)`: It’s wonderful `text(every day)`. As far as the profession goes, it’s about the best you can get.

`bbtext(JAMES SCHERR)`: This facility and all of our funds come from the private sector. We get `87%` of our revenue from sponsors and from television broadcasters. The rest comes from private donations from the American public.
`bbtext(GLEN WERNER ROSEBOOM)`: That’s exciting in that it’s truly from the grass roots up. And folks like CEOs down to your neighbor are passionate about this.

`bbtext(JAMES SCHERR)`: We believe it’s absolutely critical for the world to have an opportunity to come together peacefully at least `text(once every four years)` in the Olympic games. It’s an example of what the world could be.
